text: Final categorization: REVIEW (Justification: The paper is explicitly a review article that synthesizes existing research on the application of Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) to regional-scale sustainable development scenarios. It discusses four methodological approaches—including IAM scenario analysis, SSPs-RCPs-SPAs frameworks, downscaling of global models, and regional impact assessment models—and includes land use as one of the key domains (alongside water, energy, and ecosystem services) where SSP-based future projections are applied. While not exclusively focused on land use/land cover (LULC) prediction, it does review studies that involve LULC future prediction within regional SSP implementations, thus meeting the criterion for a 'REVIEW' classification under the instruction: “If REVIEW about or touches on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction ➔ 'REVIEW'”.)
